headline: Approved ice rink agreement extension with 595 Mix Avenue LLC and Laurel View Golf Course lease change.
summary: Council members asked about the Town's long-term plans for the golf course, the reason for extending the lease, and whether the land should be sold. The Administration said the extension would let the lessee recover its investment in roadway and parking lot work the Town cannot fund. Chair Stevens also gave an update from the Solid Waste Commission on in-vessel composting, and one resident spoke during public input.
decisions: Approved amendment and extension of the ice rink management agreement with 595 Mix Avenue LLC, 6-1.
Approved lease modification for Laurel View Golf Course, 5-1 with 1 abstention.

TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
PUBLIC WORKS, FACILITIES, & 
SUSTAINABILITY COMMITTEE 
AUGUST 17, 2026 
 
 
MINUTES DRAFT 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Committee Chair: 
Present - Ted Stevens 
Committee Vice Chair: 
Present - Grace Teodosio 
Committee Members: 
Present - Sean Cardwell 
Present - Maurine Crouch 
Present - Jeron Alston 
Present - Sarah Gallagher, Majority Leader 
Present - Bob Anthony, Minority Leader 
Present - Katie Kiely, President (Non- 
Voting Member) 
     
1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
Public Works, Facilities, & Sustainability Committee, August 17, 2026 – 7:00pm.  The 
meeting was called to order at 8:16pm with the members noted above in attendance.  
    
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION 
One member of the public provided public input.  The Public Input session was closed at 
8:21pm.   
  
 
3.  REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, AND COMMISSIONS  
Chair Stevens mentioned the update received from the Solid Waste Commission based on 
their prior meeting and noted that in-vessel composting was coming.  He also reviewed the 
year-to-date information provided by the Public Works department. 
 
  
4. UNFINISHED BUSINESS  
  1. ORDER APPROVING AN AMENDMENT AND EXTENSION OF MANAGEMENT 
SERVICES AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE TOWN OF HAMDEN AND 595 MIX 
AVENUE LLC - ICE RINK 
 
Motion to open item 4.1 was made by Chair Stevens and seconded by Majority 
Leader Gallagher.  
 
Chair Stevens reviewed the Mayor’s memo and announced the members of the Rink 
Committee. Council member Teodosio expressed interest in being added to the 
committee. Additional discussion followed on the proposed agreement changes. 
 
Chair Stevens then called for the vote. 
Vote: 6 in favor, 1 opposed (Teodosio) 0 abstentions.  Item 4.1 passed.
2 SECOND AMENDMENT ORDER AUTHORIZING THE MAYOR TO EXECUTE A 
LEASE MODIFICATION FOR LAUREL VIEW GOLF COURSE 
 
Motion to open item 4.2 was made by Chair Stevens and seconded by Pro Tem 
Cardwell.   
 
Council Members discussed the proposed lease extension, including questions 
regarding the Town's long-term plans for the property, the financial rationale for 
extending the lease, and whether the property should instead be considered for 
future sale. The Administration explained that the extension would allow the lessee to 
recover its investment in roadway and parking lot improvements that the Town was 
currently unable to fund. The Administration also noted that any future consideration 
of selling the property would require a review of restrictions affecting the property and 
that Laurel View continues to serve as an economic driver for the Town." 
 
With the discussion concluded, Chair Stevens called for the vote. 
Vote: 5 in favor, 1 opposition (Teodosio); 1 abstention (Crouch).  
    
ADJOURN  
Chair Stevens adjourned the Public Works and Sustainability Committee at 9:03pm.
